title: Introduction to Data Science: Data Wrangling and Visualisation with R for CRFS
description: The first book of the second edition of Introduction to Data Science, covering R programming, data wrangling, visualization, and productivity tools through real-world case studies. No prior R experience required - ideal as a first course in data science. This variant is adapted for CRFS: the examples and context have been changed to fit CRFS work in Africa and the Sahel.
authors: Original by Rafael A. Irizarry; this variant is for CRFS
